title: EdgeWise: Bringing Long-Horizon Agents to the Edge via Selective Cloud Delegation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17560v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Complex and long-horizon agent tasks often rely on frontier models deployed in the cloud to achieve strong performance. However, using these models for every step of a long-horizon trajectory incurs substantial inference cost, even though not all steps may require the same level of model capability. In this paper, we find that allocating the LLM to only a small subset of key steps can achieve performance comparable to full LLM execution while significantly reducing inference cost. Motivated by this observation, we propose EdgeWise, an edge-cloud collaboration framework that deploys an SLM on the local device as the primary solver and selectively delegates critical steps to a cloud LLM when stronger model capacity is needed. translated_title: EdgeWise：通过选择性云端委托将长程智能体引入边缘设备
translated_abstract: 复杂且长程的智能体任务通常依赖部署在云端的前沿模型来获得强大性能。然而，在长程轨迹的每一步都使用这些模型会产生高昂的推理成本，尽管并非所有步骤都需要同等水平的模型能力。在本文中，我们发现仅将大语言模型分配到少数关键步骤上，即可获得与完全使用大语言模型执行相当的性能，同时显著降低推理成本。基于这一观察，我们提出了EdgeWise，一种边云协同框架，它将小型语言模型部署在本地设备上作为主要求解器，并在需要更强模型能力时选择性地将关键步骤委托给云端大语言模型。为了在推理时无需额外模型即可实现自主委托，我们引入了一种步骤级强化学习方法，联合优化任务求解与委托决策，并对各个步骤进行细粒度的信用分配。
tldr: 该论文提出EdgeWise边云协同框架，通过步骤级强化学习使边缘端小型语言模型能够自主地将关键步骤委托给云端大语言模型，在保持与完全使用云端大模型相当性能的同时显著降低推理成本。
en_tdlr: EdgeWise is an edge-cloud collaboration framework that uses step-level reinforcement learning to enable an on-device SLM to autonomously delegate critical steps to a cloud LLM, achieving performance comparable to full LLM execution while significantly reducing inference cost.
